subject: Final GPU runway verification — pre-alloc hold & contingency plan
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@cobaltwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CobaltWave Procurement <procure@cobaltwave.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GPU runway check + request for short pre-alloc hold

Hi Karthik,

We're heading into final internal approvals for the CobaltWave platform launch (targeting Sept). Legal and procurement asked for a short runway assurance on dedicated capacity while we finish PO and SOW. Can you confirm the availability window for the sizing we discussed (approx: 32x A100 80GB equivalent, steady-state for first 90 days with burst to 48 GPUs for spikes)?

If possible we'd like Redwood to place a short pre-allocation (soft hold) for two weeks while we finish paperwork. Please outline any conditions or fees for holding, and whether there are fallback model variants you recommend if inventory tightens.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our execs want a clear yes/no by May 21.

Thanks,
Sara Lim
Head of Platform Ops, CobaltWave
+sara@cobaltwave.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Lim <sara@cobaltwave.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GPU runway check + request for short pre-alloc hold

Ben / Marissa — can you run an availability check for the requested footprint and advise on a two-week soft hold? Key asks from CobaltWave: 32 GPUs steady-state (A100 80GB equivalent), short bursts to 48 GPUs. If we can't guarantee exact SKU, propose compatible quantized variants and expected perf delta.

Assume start of hold window no earlier than Jun 1, but CobaltWave wants confirmation before May 21. Include costs or credit terms for a short hold and whether we can convert the soft hold to a committed reservation without allocation friction.

Cc'ing Grace for pricing/ops escalation if we hit constraints.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Quick availability snapshot attached (capacity_snapshot_may10.csv). Short summary here:

- On-hand inventory: enough capacity to cover 32x A10080-equivalent across dedicated pools in us-west for a Jun 1 start, with a conservative buffer for 7--10 days.
- Burst capacity to 48 GPUs is feasible by shifting two spare nodes from our flexible pool (expected perf within ~5% for most LLM serving profiles).
- Risk: late cancellations from two queued trials could reduce burst headroom; ops will monitor and flag by May 25.

Proposed soft-hold terms (internal recommendation):
- Place a 14-day "soft pre-alloc" for CobaltWave with hold code: SOFTHOLD-CW467. No upfront payment; a nominal $2,500 credit hold fee that converts against first monthly invoice if they sign within the hold window.
- If converted to a Commitment (Reserved Capacity) within the 14 days, apply standard reservation SLOs and discount tier CW-STD-2.
- Fallback: if A10080 inventory tightens, offer quantized A100q variants (3-bit / 4-bit) — expected median latency increase ~8% on their gen profile; we can provide comparative evals before conversion.

Attachments: capacity_snapshot_may10.csv (contains node-by-node mapping and projected node churn).

Ben Carter
Senior Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference
Attachments: capacity_snapshot_may10.csv

Sara — confirming we can place the 14-day soft pre-allocation for CobaltWave. Details below: 

- Hold code: SOFTHOLD-CW467
- Size: 32x A10080-equivalent steady-state with burst headroom to 48 GPUs (as detailed in our capacity snapshot).
- Window: 2027-06-01 00:00 PST through 2027-06-15 23:59 PST.
- Terms: $2,500 refundable credit hold fee; if you sign a reservation/commitment before 2027-06-15, the fee will apply to month-1 invoice. If not converted, fee covers ops overhead and is non-refundable.

Next steps for CobaltWave:
1) Sign the attached prealloc_terms_draft.pdf and submit PO or indicate intent to execute via HubSpot link below.
2) If you need a short perf eval on a 3-bit quantized A100 variant, Ben will run a targeted benchmark within 48 hours post-signing.

I've included a DocuSign link and HubSpot record for easy conversion: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890 and https://redwoodinference.app/docusign/CW-2026-089

Ben / Ops: please set the soft hold in the provisioning queue and flag any node churn that would materially affect burst headroom. Notify Karthik + Sara if an escalation path is needed before May 25.

Sara — we appreciate the quick collaboration. Give me a one-line when you've initiated the signature and I'll confirm hold activation from our side.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
